lesson: The system consistently attempted to short assets already in an extreme markdown phase, leading to stop-outs during local oversold mean-reversion bounces. By ignoring the Wyckoff principle of 'stopping volume' and local liquidity sweeps, the strategy repeatedly entered at the point of maximum bearish exhaustion.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Volume Climax' filter that prohibits short entries when RSI is below 20 on the 15m timeframe until a confirmed retest of a broken support level occurs.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps more and pure trend-following momentum less during extreme oversold conditions.
